measures.action: Shut off the fans and ventilation so the air stops moving.

effect.text: Engineering proposal (hypothesis for the engine): with less airflow the flame spreads slower or starves (ACME BRE, PSI-20: flames went out in still air at 21 % O2 in microgravity). In this model the effect depends on oxygen and gravity; it is not tested for this place.
effect.src: Action: NTRS 20030053429 (ISS fire response closes the intermodule ventilation valves and the cabin fans). Effect: PSI-20 ACME BRE, DOI 10.60555/vb93-3y72; hypothesis for racks

measures.action: Discharge the portable CO2 fire extinguisher on the burning rack.

effect.text: Engineering proposal (hypothesis): the engine puts out the fire in the component where it started at that moment and stops its spread. The US segment carries CO2 portable extinguishers; the effect on a real rack fire is not tested here, and the crew need breathing equipment after a CO2 discharge.
effect.src: Action: NTRS 20130011664 (CO2 extinguishers in the US Orbital Segment) and NTRS 20030053429 (crew can use the PFE at their discretion). Effect: hypothesis

measures.action: Put a fire-blocking barrier between rack 1 and rack 2 so a fire cannot cross.

effect.text: Engineering proposal (hypothesis): the engine removes this connection. A barrier breaks the continuous fuel path that the model assumes. No test of such a barrier exists in the sources used.
effect.src: Hypothesis; flame spread needs continuous fuel (stated, not measured, for this place)

gaps: The inside of the module is a procedural scene, not a NASA model: the eight racks, their order and the one-metre links between them are illustrative. No drawing of a real module was used.
No PSI/NTRS combustion test exists for an ISS rack. Spread speeds are the SAFFIRE anchor scaled by estimated factors and each rack is one 'plastic' material class.
Racks are linked in a ring with open fuel paths (worst case); real racks are separated by gaps, structure and fire-blocking materials that this model does not know.
Energetic components: none verified. The gas tanks and batteries of the station are outside this scene and were not verified with a source, so there is no rupture here.
The hull, light strips, handrails, end ring, bulkhead and burner probe are structure or fixtures: declared not simulated (non-combustible or not a component).
Detection and the crew's actions are not modelled: the times are for an unattended fire.
